subject: history
concept: Analyzing a current or historical policy debate from multiple genuine perspectives
source_inspiration: original content, following the Education Conduct Policy's evenhandedness principle — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student sorts arguments on a policy debate into 'for' and 'against' columns, each with real supporting reasoning
exercise.abstract: Student presents the strongest genuine argument on each side of a described policy debate, without stating a personal opinion

misconception_flags: presents one side's argument as a weak strawman rather than its strongest genuine form

interest_binding: policy topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where age-appropriate
